caption: The drawing shows two aged, rectangular pieces of paper positioned side by side on a plain, off-white background. Each paper is light brown, showing signs of age through visible discoloration, creases, and tape marks that suggest repairs or preservation efforts. The left paper contains printed and handwritten text in black ink, with portions of the handwriting in darker ink and some fading present. The printed text at the top reads, “By His Excellency George Washington, Esq.” with spaces filled in by handwriting including a name, a regiment, a duration of service (seven years), and a signature at the bottom. The paper on the right also displays printed text at the top followed by additional printed lines and the signature "George Washington" at the bottom. The edges of both documents are worn and slightly irregular. There are various watermarks, stains, and signs of folding throughout both papers. Both documents are centered on a larger sheet of clean, unmarked paper except for a small, faint printed name “John Korn” in the bottom right margin.
title: Certificate (army discharge)
